explication: Agentation is a browser-embedded visual feedback tool. A user activates the toolbar, selects page elements, text, or regions, enters an annotation, and the client identifies context, persists it locally, optionally synchronizes it to the MCP service, and produces structured output for an AI coding agent. Design mode adds wireframe placements and rearrangement. The MCP package provides HTTP/MCP access, sessions, events, SQLite-backed storage, tenant support, and optional webhooks. Wiring is based on sampled imports and README capabilities; several server routes were not sampled.
